statement.zh: **术语**：GCM 认证加密模式（Galois/Counter Mode (GCM)）。**定义**：GCM 认证加密模式。CTR 加密 + GHASH 认证，一步到位的 AEAD。
statement.en: **Term**: Galois/Counter Mode (GCM).It is registered under symmetric block ciphers.

statement.zh: CTR 加密 + GHASH 认证，一步到位的 AEAD。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in symmetric block ciphers, not because of its name.
